categories.name: جَزَاءُ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي النَّبَإِ
categories.nameEn: Rewards of the Pious in Surah An-Naba

items.verseEn: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
[As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,

categories.name: أَحْدَاثُ يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي سُورَةِ الحَاقَّةِ
categories.nameEn: Events of the Day of Judgment in Surah Al-Haqqah

items.verse: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ
items.verseEn: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast

items.verse: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ
items.verseEn: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow [i.e., stroke] -
And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.

items.verse: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌۭ
items.verseEn: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.

categories.name: صِفَاتُ عِبَادِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ
categories.nameEn: Attributes of the Servants of the Most Merciful in Surah Al-Furqan

items.verse: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
items.verseEn: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."

items.verse: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًۭا
items.verseEn: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate

items.verse: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِٱللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا۟ كِرَامًۭا
items.verseEn: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.

categories.name: اِتِّهَامَاتٌ نُفِيَتْ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Accusations Denied Against the Prophet in the Quran

items.verse: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌۭ كَذَّابٌ
items.verseEn: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.

items.verse: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍۢ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
items.verseEn: So remind, [O Muḥammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

items.verse: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
items.verseEn: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
And your companion [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) ] is not [at all] mad.

harf.hint: One of Allah's Beautiful Names, meaning Most Generous and Noble — it follows 'Rabb' in a verse asking mankind what deceived them about their Lord
harf.arabicVerse: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
harf.verse: 82:6 - O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,

deduction.title: The Pledge of the Womb
deduction.intro: In the silent chambers of a heart devoted to the Divine, a sacred vow was conceived. This vow centered on a life yet to draw breath, and its fulfillment would alter the course of spiritual legacy forever. Step into the mystery of a soul whose promise echoed through eternity.
clues: I lived in a household known for its piety, and I yearned for a gift that would bring me nearer to Allah.
I made a solemn covenant with my Lord concerning what was hidden within me, vowing to devote it wholly to His service.
When the moment of unveiling came, what I received was unexpected, but I entrusted the matter to the All-Knowing.
I gave my child a name signifying devotion, and I pleaded for protection for her and her descendants from the accursed one.
My child was placed in the sacred sanctuary, under the guardianship of a prophet from the lineage of Aaron.
My daughter became known for her purity and was chosen above all women, later being the mother of a great prophet, though remaining untouched.

The mother of Musa

The wife of Al-Aziz
The mother of Isa

A test of patience through a long illness
A journey to a distant land for the sake of faith
A confrontation with a tyrant king
A miraculous provision of food from heaven

options: The child named Maryam
The staff that turned into a snake
The golden calf
The well of Zamzam
The ark of Noah

outcome.label: Outcome

Her child became a prophet and received a scripture
Her child was raised to the heavens
Her child built a sacred house

deduction.arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
deduction.verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)

scramble.hint: Allah's miraculous protection of Prophet Ibrahim when his people threw him into a blazing fire — a story of absolute trust (tawakkul) and divine rescue.
scramble.arabic: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًۭا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
scramble.verseEn: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."
